1. How do I participate in this stock transfer promotion?

No registration is required. Once an eligible user completes their first stock transfer during the promotion, the system automatically calculates the reward based on the amount actually received. Each user can only earn a reward for their first stock transfer.
Transfer stocks in just three steps:
Submit a stock transfer request on Bitget and provide the delivering broker's name and the name and quantity of the stocks to be transferred;
Using the transfer details provided by Bitget, submit a stock transfer-out request to the delivering broker;
Once the stocks have been credited, the system will automatically complete the remaining steps.
Users can check their stock transfer status in real time using the "Track Progress" button on the page.
U.S. stock transfers from Bitget Stock+ to rToken are free of charge but are not eligible for rewards under this promotion.
2. Which stocks can be transferred to Bitget?
The stocks and ETFs currently eligible for transfer are listed on the Bitget stock transfer page.
If a stock is not currently eligible for transfer, users will not be able to select it on the transfer page.
3. Can amounts from multiple stock transfers be combined to calculate rewards?
Rewards for this promotion are calculated only from the amount received in your first stock transfer. Any transfers after that are not eligible for rewards.
4. When will the rewards be distributed?
Round 1: The 2nd day after the first stock transfer is credited.
Round 2: The 1st month after the first stock transfer is credited.
Round 3: The 2nd month after the first stock transfer is credited.
5. Can sub-accounts receive rewards by transferring stocks?
Only users' main accounts are eligible for this promotion. Sub-accounts support all stock transfer features but cannot participate in this promotion.
6. Why might some rewards not be distributed?
Before each reward installment is distributed, the system verifies the current value of your rToken holdings.
If your rToken holdings are worth less than 80% of the value credited from your first transfer at that time, the reward for that round will not be distributed.
7. How long does a stock transfer usually take? What if it fails?
The time required depends on the delivering broker's processing efficiency, the settlement status of the stocks, and whether the transfer information is complete.

Users can check the current stock transfer status under "Track progress". If the transfer fails, they can resubmit it based on the reason shown on the page or contact Bitget customer service for assistance.
8. How do I check my stock transfer progress and reward status?

Users can select "Track progress" on the promotion page to view the current stock transfer status, including transfer initiated, awaiting transfer-out by the delivering broker, stocks credited, and subsequent processing.
Reward details can be viewed in the "Reward Center," including the actual stock transfer amount, applicable reward tier, reward amount, and distribution status of each round.

Rewards for this promotion are calculated only from the amount received in your first stock transfer. Any transfers after that are not eligible for rewards.

Only users' main accounts are eligible for this promotion. Sub-accounts support all stock transfer features but cannot participate in this promotion.

Before each reward installment is distributed, the system verifies the current value of your rToken holdings.

The time required depends on the delivering broker's processing efficiency, the settlement status of the stocks, and whether the transfer information is complete.

Users can check the current stock transfer status under "Track progress". If the transfer fails, they can resubmit it based on the reason shown on the page or contact Bitget customer service for assistance.
